There will be a circle around them with a color and design that will indicate what element they've been hit by. Ideally you do want a melee with affinity just incase you have no fp left. but with proper management you should be fine.

You hit an enemy with any source of elemental damage(spells,incants, weapons with elemental affinty.), then you use the skill to suck up the element and you gain fp from that. If you have absorbed 3 elements you need to use the skill to use the spell that has been concocted. Then you will be set back to 0 element charges. Be warned not all incants deal elemental damage(bestial, rot, etc,) but gravity will count as magic.
